question:
An engineer must design an automation solution for the Cisco ACI Fabric to speed up the deployment of logical network elements for tenant provisioning. When creating a solution, the engineer must keep in mind that the tool must support these requirements:
* Allow the rapid creation and removal of logical containers.
* Support the creation of custom modules and data structures.
* Be extensible with external libraries and modules.
* Allow rapid testing of code using an on-demand execution environment.
Which automation tool meets these requirements?
theory: The requirements — rapid creation/removal of logical containers, custom modules and data structures, extensibility with external libraries, and an on-demand interactive execution environment — describe the traits of a general-purpose programming language rather than a fixed-syntax automation DSL. On-box or Guest Shell Python (including the ACI Python SDK) provides exactly this: an interactive REPL, importable custom/external modules, and full programmatic control, unlike YAML (a static data format), SaltStack, or Chef, whose configuration languages are far less flexible for this kind of rapid ad hoc scripting. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 17 — Evaluate Automation and Orchestration Technologies)
